body.message:
Thank you. To confirm: I stayed normally from June 21 to June 23. The incident occurred on the night of June 24, making the property uninhabitable from that point. I have not returned since.
A refund for June 24 and 25 is therefore the correct basis — I accept that in principle.

However, this must also include reimbursement of the 700 AED I spent on emergency alternative accommodation on June 25, booked at my own expense after receiving no response from your team for over 10 hours.
Please confirm the total refund amount including the 700 AED, and the processing timeline.
